name: ares_protocol_v1
frozen: 2026-10-29, written before any new score in this folder was computed
what_this_is: ARES (arXiv 2507.12948v2, EMNLP 2025) READOUT protocol applied to our stored step scores. NOT a rerun of ARES's entailment-stability method (that needs many LLM calls per step). CPU only, no new inference.
prior_exposure: Before freezing, the following existing numbers had already been seen: results/prm_boost_collection_v1/tables/COMP_ARES.csv (PRM_native, TELE_N16, CHAIN_N16 backbone under this readout), SUB5_ALL.csv GAP rows, stage8 AUTO GAP PRMScore. All data are development data.

readout.threshold: one global threshold per (cell, arm), chosen on the 4 training folds to maximize pooled Macro-F1, applied to the held-out fold
readout.grid: 99 quantiles np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, 99) of the arm's score on the training-fold kept steps
readout.score_swept: PRM arm: its raw stored risk (PRM_native on PRMBench, PRM on DeltaBench). Fused arms: per-answer z (E.answer_z), as collection_competitors.thr_score
readout.folds: 5 folds; groups assigned round-robin after rng=np.random.default_rng(20261021).permutation(unique groups of non-control answers)
readout.report: pooled over all out-of-fold decisions on kept steps: Macro-F1, Macro-Precision, Macro-Recall (two classes: valid step and erroneous step, unweighted mean), plus the SD of the 5 per-fold Macro-F1 values
readout.scale: 0-100 (ARES publishes 0-1; multiply theirs by 100 to compare)

prmbench.cells: E.load('prmbench', prm) = backbone cell; E.load('prmbench', prm + '__standalone') = standalone telemetry cell (loaded through results/prm_sub5_all_benchmarks_v1/sub5_all.py)
prmbench.population: all 6,969 answers; metric pool = steps of the non-control answers (c.keep), the official PRMBench pool
prmbench.groups: c.groups = the cell's source_group field (prmb_source_v2 ids; the v3 label release keeps these groups). This is what competitors.ares_rows already uses.

deltabench.status: partial coverage: the 447-answer 'common' set of evaluate_cab (of 1,236 DeltaBench answers); units are the DeltaBench sections as segmented in crop_ares_v1 inputs
deltabench.cells: key 'cab|prm|deltabench' registered in A.REG with A.common_uids('deltabench') (backbone mode)
deltabench.groups: no source-group field exists (source_id is unique per answer); groups = exact whitespace-normalized lowercase question text (1,217 unique questions among 1,236 answers), else the answer
deltabench.macro_f1_code: same fold/grid/threshold loop as ares_rows, re-implemented with E.counts_by_answer so the metric equals evaluate_cab.row's macro_f1 form (0.5*(F1 valid + F1 error) x100)

label_free_contrast: each arm also under our GAP rule on the same rows (PRMBench: E.official PRMScore of c.flags(arm,'GAP'); the PRM's GAP row uses its STATUS_META scale arm PRM_Q80 or PRM_Q80_PROB; DeltaBench: evaluate_cab.row macro_f1, PRM scale arm from A.prm_scale_arm), with Macro-P / Macro-R from the same pooled counts

bootstrap.what: paired difference AUTO minus PRM in out-of-fold Macro-F1 under the ARES readout; the fold thresholds are held fixed (out-of-fold decisions resampled, threshold not re-tuned inside the bootstrap)

parity_checks: PRMBench macro_f1_oof of every (prm, arm) present in COMP_ARES.csv (PRM_native, TELE_N16, CHAIN_N16) reproduced exactly (abs diff <= 1e-9)
own fold loop (used for P/R and bootstrap) reproduces ares_rows macro_f1_oof exactly for every PRMBench arm
AUTO GAP PRMScore vs stage8/AUTO_FORCEDK_RESULTS.json gap_prmscore, tol 1e-6
PRM GAP PRMScore and backbone/standalone TELE_N16, MEAN_N16, CHAIN_N16 GAP vs SUB5_ALL.csv, tol 1e-6
DeltaBench: AUTO GAP macro-F1 vs AUTO_NEW.csv; PRM, TELE_N16, CHAIN_N16 GAP vs SUB5_ALL.csv, tol 1e-6
stop_rule: any failed parity check: write PARITY.json and exit 3 without RESULTS
